scope: Qualified exact stable R 4.6.1 private Linux build, base/stats/utils only: bounded numeric additive unweighted OLS with 1–8 predictors, optional intercept, explicit training/held-out rows, independent scaled Householder QR and rectangular infinity-condition guard, native RDS fresh reopen, named finite error/prediction requirements and Calc table handoff/reuse. Native 1/3/8-predictor with/without-intercept models, predictor scales 1e-8 to 1e8 and tiny response 1e-100 passed. Unmet requirements block downstream execution and successful reuse. 2026-10-16 addition on the same 4.6.1 runtime: opt-in classical coefficient inference through stats::summary.lm, stats::confint and stats::pf (standard errors, t, two-sided p, intervals at levels 0.5–0.999, sigma, centred/uncentred R-squared, overall F), checked against independent QR inference, exact rational normal equations and closed-form t quantiles; coefficientInterval requirements and an exact-fit NO_RESIDUAL_VARIANCE guard. Latest stable remained 4.6.1 on the CRAN R-4 source index that date. No arbitrary authored code, categorical/weighted models, imported RDS, prediction intervals, multiplicity adjustment or future-generalisation guarantee.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_r.py with exact target Rscript and Calc, and native adaptor conformance; require independent known-model baseline/variant, heldout, model-reopen/tamper and unmet handoff/reuse gates, plus closed-form and exact-rational coefficient inference, level readback, uncentred no-intercept, imprecise-interval unmet, exact-fit rejection and forged p-value gates.
